text:
Predicates:
FliesTo(x, y) ::: x flies to y.
From(x, y) ::: x flies from y.
Airport(x) ::: x is an airport.
Premises:
Susan flies to LGA airport ::: FliesTo(Susan, LGA).
The departure and arrival can not be the same airport ::: ∀x ∀y (FliesTo(x, y) → y ≠ x).
John flies from LGA airport ::: From(John, LGA).

Conclusion:
FliesTo(Susan, LGA)
